summary: The AAP Operator gives push-button deployment of AAP on OpenShift, with resource types for automation controller, private automation hub and controller jobs, plus upgrades and full lifecycle support; install it from the Red Hat Operators catalog in OperatorHub.
questions: What is the Ansible Automation Platform Operator?
Why use the operator instead of a playbook to install AAP on OpenShift?
Where do I get the AAP Operator?
